answer: Randomized Witness Lotteries. Each epoch, a verifiable randomness beacon draws a small witness panel from all identities to audit a raven-selected subset of peers' work; only panel members earn copper rewards, and unselected identities gain nothing. Attackers must split effort across many clones, each with a tiny, unpredictable chance of selection, so per-identity expected payoff stays near zero. The summit cost is buying many identities that mostly idle without reward while their clone count dilutes each one's odds.
